name: acceler-local
description: Local marketplace hosting the Acceler B2B pre-sales and post-sales/delivery plugins (together: Acceler Atlas).

plugins.name: acceler-presales
plugins.description: Acceler Atlas — turns discovery, precedent-matching, proposal writing, deck generation, pricing and instructor staffing into slash commands, powered by the Acceler Knowledge Graph (61 clients · 1,072 files · 773 instructors). 7 skills, one SKILL.md each — discovery-checklist, doc-proposal, mini-ut-context, pricing, proposal-deck, pptx-deck, requirement-mapping — plus 9 commands. Delivery/post-sales artifacts live in the companion acceler-post-sales plugin below.

plugins.name: acceler-post-sales
plugins.description: Acceler B2B Post-Sales / Delivery orchestrator — session deck (live delivery HTML deck) → pick your use case (standalone Build Lab chooser) → session recap (post-delivery learner recap) → session recap report (post-delivery stakeholder analytics).
